name: 07621 · Bergenfield, NJ
findings: ZIP 07621 (Bergenfield) has 105 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 07621 (Bergenfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
42% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 07621 (Bergenfield) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 50% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
